craft_notes: Sthāyin: Śambhu's view (purity remembered, then refused: neither-neither). Rows: row 3 (view→may be). Close: may be (optative — happiness permitted, not promised). Rejected: 'beyond good and evil' — killed: pure-impure kept (śuci-aśuci as ritual pair, precise); 'Śiva's view' — killed: Śambhu's kept (the beneficent-name is the verse's choice; diacritic exact).

lines: Slightly knowing remembered purity — Śambhu's view:
neither pure nor impure — thought-free, happy may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcijjñair yā smṛtā śuddhiḥ sā śuddhiḥ śambhudarśane | na śucir hy aśucis tasmān nirvikalpaḥ sukhī bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What is the true purity? → In Śambhu's view neither pure nor impure — thought-free happiness instead.
c1_essence: Neither pure nor impure in Śambhu's view: thought-free happy.
